name: O Block
notes: Speaker on the balcony, two-minute noodles, and a party that starts in someone's room.

name: R Block
notes: The corridor goes still after ten. Bring earplugs only if you snore.

name: S Block
notes: Courtyard soccer until the floodlight clicks off, then someone shares the fridge.

name: ADD REMAINING ON-CAMPUS BLOCKS HERE
notes: Not playable. Add each remaining on-campus block as its own row when the letters are settled.

name: Jacaranda Court
notes: Campus flats under the jacarandas. The guard knows your name. Single and two-bed.

name: Cane Crescent
notes: Two-bed sharing and a kitchen that always smells like stew. A short bus, then you are home.

name: Harbour Walk
notes: The cheap rooms by the sea. The bus eats the evening and the breeze gives a little of it back.

name: Mango Yard
notes: Plastic chairs, a braai drum, and someone who will shout that the taxi is here.

name: Lantern House
notes: Fresh paint and a quiet study room on the second floor. The walls are thinner than the brochure.

name: Taxi Terrace
notes: You live on the route. Cheap, loud at six, and never short of a lift.

name: Fig Tree Flats
notes: Close enough to walk when the bus is full. The fig tree out front is the landmark.

name: Night Market Rooms
notes: Above the evening stalls. Cheap rent, late dinners, and a morning that starts too early.

name: Blue Crane House
notes: A leased house with a stoep. Someone is always borrowing sugar, and someone always has notes.

name: Kite Hill Rooms
notes: Plain rooms up a windy hill. The view is the amenity.

name: Gold Window
notes: Gold tint on the glass, a lobby that stays quiet, and wifi that actually holds.

name: Stoep House
notes: Almost on campus. The stoep is where the group chat happens out loud.

name: Raincloud Flats
notes: The frugal lease. You pack lunch, you learn the timetable, you still make the test.

name: Drummer's Rest
notes: Someone is always rehearsing. You will know the chorus. You will also know your earplugs.

name: Library Lane
notes: A walk-up for people who treat Friday like a study date.

name: Spice Route
notes: A shared kitchen that feeds the floor. The long ride home is the tax.

name: Palm Gate
notes: The closest lease. You can hear the campus and still make an eight o'clock.

name: Red Dust House
notes: Far, hot, and honest about it. The rent leaves money for a kota.

name: Veranda House
notes: A plain good room. Not a story. A door that locks and a desk that fits.

name: Amber Lodge
notes: Accredited and serious about quiet hours. You are paying for the hush.

name: Cedar Rooms
notes: A short walk and a warden who actually does the rounds.

name: North Studio
notes: A private studio. You pay to be alone with the laptop, and you forget to eat.

name: Marula House
notes: Accredited house, big pots, and a rules page on the fridge.

name: Twin Palm
notes: A small courtyard and a short roll of neighbours. You will know everyone by week two.

name: Corner House
notes: The nearest accredited house. Home between lectures is a real option.

name: Lotus Rooms
notes: Quiet, a longer ride, and a kitchen that closes at ten.

name: Chapel Yard
notes: Early nights and a courtyard that smells like rain on warm brick.

name: Off campus (other)
notes: A room the list does not name. No res bonus until it has its own story.
